subject: What happens during a home consultation
hook: Is the consultation really free, and will I be pushed into going ahead?
fb:
The question behind a lot of hesitant messages: is the consultation really free, and will I feel pressured afterwards?

It is free, and there is no obligation. We come and talk through the room, your ideas and finish samples. If you want to take it further, we measure accurately and send an itemised quote, with every part of the job listed so you can see what you are paying for.

Then it is your call. Take your time, come back with questions, change the spec, or decide it is not for you. Plenty of people get in touch months later when the timing is right.

Arrange a consultation or just ask us a question here:
https://superiofurniture.com/contact/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=autumn-interiors-and-practical-comfort&utm_content=day-056
gbp:
Is the SUPERIO design consultation really free?

Yes. Every project starts with a free, no-obligation design consultation. We talk through how you use the room, what needs storing, and the finishes and handles you like, and we look at anything that affects the design, such as sockets, radiators or uneven walls.

If you want to go further, we measure the room accurately and send an itemised quote. Pricing is transparent, every part of the job is listed, and there are no hidden costs. You can take as long as you need to decide, ask questions, or adjust the design.

If you go ahead, your furniture is made in our own workshop in Hanley, quality-checked, then delivered and installed by our own team. We cover Stoke-on-Trent, Staffordshire and the surrounding area, for kitchens, wardrobes, media walls, home offices and more.

Use the button below to arrange your consultation or ask us a question.
